services.name: Tiki Boat Tour
services.desc: Your private Tiki Tour of the Chain of Lakes! Duration 3 hours About Enjoy a leisurely cruise in our fun 8 passenger tiki-boat. Your tiki boat rental includes a boat captain who will take you out on the water to explore the chain of lakes in the region! More info 21 + to book the tour however all ages can be on the boat as long as accompanied by an adult. Boat comes with a licensed Captain! Includes speakers with Bluetooth or AUX capability and a porta-potty for "emergency" use. Please Note - No smoking or vaping and no glass on the Tiki Boat (bring drinks in cans or bring a tumbler for your refills!)
